words.example: Archive the volunteer sign-in sheets once the year is closed.
words.exampleZh: 这一年结束后，请把志愿者签到表归档。

words.example: Please use revision three, because the visiting rules changed.
words.exampleZh: 请用第三修订版，因为探视规定已经改了。

words.example: This is only a draft, so please do not circulate it yet.
words.exampleZh: 这还只是草稿，先不要传阅。

words.example: Please CC (Carbon Copy) the ward sister when you write to a family.
words.exampleZh: 给家属写信时，请 CC（抄送）护士长。

words.example: BCC (Blind Carbon Copy) the manager when the message concerns a complaint.
words.exampleZh: 邮件涉及投诉时，请 BCC（密送）经理。

words.example: Voice recognition wrote 'no allergy' when the doctor said 'known allergy'.
words.exampleZh: 医生说的是“已知过敏”，语音识别却写成了“无过敏”。

words.example: Speech-to-text dropped the dose when the doctor dictated too fast.
words.exampleZh: 医生口述太快时，语音转文字把剂量漏掉了。

words.example: The allergy alert fired when penicillin was ordered for this patient.
words.exampleZh: 给这位患者开青霉素时，过敏警示弹了出来。

words.example: The drug interaction warning stopped the second sedative from being signed.
words.exampleZh: 药物相互作用警告拦住了第二张镇静药，没让它签下去。

words.example: A duplicate order for the chest X-ray was signed twice this morning.
words.exampleZh: 今天早上，胸部X线这张重复医嘱被签了两次。
